messages:
alex: Alert: 03:42 UTC — elevated 95p token latency for inference service in eu-west-1. Alert ID: inf-latency-2026-03-17-41325. Automatic mitigation didn't kick (burst throttle). Opening war room: https://warroom.redwood.com/r/41325-abc
oncall-bot: Pager sent to maria (pager#1) and raj. Runbooks: /runbooks/inference/latency.md
maria: I'm on it — joining war room now. initial checks: node 7 high GPU mem, KV cache evictions rising.
raj: jumping in to check routing & autoscale events. will validate if any recent deploys.
alex: assigning owner: maria (incident owner). Maria please confirm ownership and if you want me to notify customers.
maria: I accept ownership. Confirming paging to customers if we see >10% error or sustained >200ms 95p for 5m. I'll update status page draft.
sam (product-ops): Can you draft a short statuspage + customer email? I'll review and send once approved. Need clear impact, affected regions, suggested workaround (if any).
emily (statuspage-bot): Draft statuspage update ready for review:

```
Status: Investigating
Affected systems: Inference API (eu-west-1)
Impact: Increased response latency for some requests affecting throughput and conversational sessions. Error rate unchanged.
Detected: 03:42 UTC
Mitigation: Team is investigating; no user-facing rollback yet.
Next update: in 15 minutes or sooner.
```

Please prod for wording.
alex: Suggest adding "customers using Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 may see higher latency" and include war room link.
maria: Updated draft — adding note about Dedicated pools and temporary routing fallback. New draft:

```
Status: Investigating
Affected systems: Inference API (eu-west-1)
Impact: Elevated latency for requests routed to eu-west-1. This may impact Dedicated and Hosted customers using eu-west-1. Error rates remain within normal range; throughput and conversational latency degraded.
Detected: 03:42 UTC
Mitigation: Teams are investigating; temporary cross-region routing may be enabled for some customers.
Next update: in 15 minutes.
```

sam: Customer email template (short):

```
Subject: Brief: Redwood inference latency in eu-west-1 — investigating
Body: Hi — we're investigating increased latency impacting inference in eu-west-1. Our engineers are actively working on mitigations; no data loss is suspected. We'll send updates every 15 minutes. If you have questions or are seeing severe impact, reply here or contact your CSM.
```

raj: Quick findings: a recent autoscaling policy didn't trigger due to a config threshold change in the pool. Sending the config diff to war room.
alex: @oncall-bot please confirm pager escalation policy if we need secondary paging.
oncall-bot: Secondary paging escalated to ops-team@redwood after 10m without mitigation.
maria: Working a temporary routing tweak to shift some traffic to eu-central-1; will coordinate with infra. I'll post an update when traffic begins shifting.
sam: I'll prep the outbound message and hold until you confirm wording — likely go after the first mitigation step.
emily (statuspage-bot): Noted. I'll publish the statuspage draft on approval. Need "publish" from incident owner.
maria: Approve publish of current statuspage draft. alex please post customer email once we confirm traffic shift.
alex: Acknowledged. publishing statuspage now and will queue customer email pending shift success. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Statuspage update published by alex at 03:45 UTC
maria: Update: traffic shift started at 03:50 UTC, initial latency 95p improving. continuing to monitor.
alex: Thanks team. I'll update this thread if anything changes; next update in 10 minutes or on material change. :thumbsup:
